spatial_claims.claim: D is a point on segment BC such that the rectangle BD by DC equals one-fourth of the square on A
E is the midpoint of BC, so BE = EC
BC is cut into equal segments at E and unequal segments at D (application of Prop 2.5)
BD = EC + ED and DC = EC - ED, implying D lies between E and C on segment BC

DF is merely a constructed length equal to 2 times ED, not a point placed in any complex spatial relationship. The entire configuration is one-dimensional with no angles, triangles, circles, or complex geometric figures.
